title: Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.35884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.   We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-prese

translated_title: 横向子空间中的学习：无散算子学习的最小表示
translated_abstract: 无散向量场是不可压缩流动和许多偏微分方程系统中的基本状态变量。冗余的参数化方法，包括神经守恒律（NCL）势函数，会将多个辅助表示映射到同一个物理场。我们的实验表明，这种冗余可以通过扩大等价解的集合来降低静态表示拟合误差，但由此产生的多对一映射并不能为算子学习提供唯一的状态。我们引入了一种最小表示方法，将D维区域上的实值D分量无散向量场编码为同一区域上的实值(D-1)分量场。利用不可压缩性在傅里叶空间中施加的横向结构，我们使用Householder正交变换直接构造降维坐标。对于周期性和封闭不可渗透场，该变换是可逆的、等距的，并且保持角度……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Householder正交变换的最小表示方法，将D维区域上的D分量无散向量场编码为(D-1)分量场，该变换可逆、等距且保角，解决了传统冗余参数化多对一映射无法为算子学习提供唯一状态的问题。
